page.overview:
Who is Archibald Desnay?

Archibald Desnay is a well-respected philosopher in Whitestone and was once the chancellor to Frederick de Rolo, Percy's father. As an NPC, Archibald was portrayed by Matthew Mercer.

Archibald Desnay appeared in The Legend of Vox Machina, where he was re-imagined as a young rebel leader voiced by Dominic Monaghan.

Appearance Archibald Desnay is a very elderly man with a very thin, frail form. His weathered skin is dark and leathery, with liver spots all over his nearly hairless scalp. One of his eyes is clouded over in white. When Vox Machina first met him, he was wearing ragged robes draped over his body.

Personality Archibald speaks with power, resonance, and confidence, giving off the impression that he is a man of great power and respect. He is stern and can be crotchety at times.
